reason: A settings plugin for DeepSeek Harness that configures per-model reasoning levels, input modalities, context windows, token capacities, and sparse official-model overrides without managing provider credentials or lifecycle.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DeepSeek Harness 设置中编辑模型推理级别、输入模态、上下文窗口、最大令牌数及官方模型覆盖项的配置插件。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness settings plugin for editing per-model reasoning levels, input modalities, context windows, token capacities, and official-model overrides.

capabilities: Edit per-model reasoning-effort declarations and wire spellings
Edit input modality declarations including image support
Apply sparse capability overrides to official model catalog routes
Manage capability settings through a web settings panel
